bounded_contexts.name: model-routing
bounded_contexts.description: Routes dispatch envelopes to the correct provider given tenant, audience, modality, and pack constraints. Preview foundation now includes kernel/domain/usecase layers with metadata-only idempotency, policy/trace/registry evidence refs, fail-closed route denial receipts, and no provider calls or runtime dispatch.

bounded_contexts.name: providers
bounded_contexts.description: Per-vendor adapters for 18 first-class providers. Each implements ProviderAdapterPort.

bounded_contexts.name: guardrails
bounded_contexts.description: Pre-call + post-call refusal stack: CSAM, violence, self-harm, PCI, EU AI Act Annex III, minor-protection, prompt-injection, jailbreak, credential-exfil.

bounded_contexts.name: eval
bounded_contexts.description: Preview metadata-only evaluation foundation for release gates, guardrail calibration, and output-quality evidence. Kernel/domain/usecase source-level crates score, policy-validate, and idempotently orchestrate eval set metadata with audit event records; the adapter source-level crate builds hosted-runner envelopes and maps runner outcome metadata without network execution; the worker source-level crate validates leased eval jobs, runs the usecase, dispatches metadata-only adapter envelopes, and computes deterministic retry/deferred receipts without queue or runner I/O; binary/queue/runtime eval execution remains future work.

bounded_contexts.name: attribution
bounded_contexts.description: Preview metadata-only citation planning and worker orchestration for RAG-backed responses per EU AI Act Art. 13 transparency. Kernel/domain/usecase/adapter/worker source-level crates map answer segment refs to source/resource/evidence refs, bind planning to tenant/principal policy decisions, enforce external audience data-class boundaries plus surface/source/confidence/citation caps, add idempotent orchestration with requested/rendered/denied/conflict audit-event metadata, build metadata-only citation-renderer envelopes with HTTPS/non-local endpoint, credential/audit/renderer refs, usecase receipt binding, and renderer outcome mapping, and process leased worker attempts with not-before deferral plus deterministic retry/exhaustion/nonretry mapping; attribution runtime, durable queues, network execution, retrieval execution, and citation text rendering remain future work.

bounded_contexts.name: brand-ux-surface
bounded_contexts.description: Layer-B consumer brand chrome: SparkleIcon, StreamingText, TierBadge, RefusalBanner, CostFloorDisclosure, CitationCard.

bounded_contexts.name: credential-resolver
bounded_contexts.description: Resolves SecretReference → CredentialHandle via OpenBao sidecar. Credentials never enter intelligence process memory per ADR-0296; the metadata-only credential sidecar adapter validates sidecar channel/signer/audit/audience refs, builds request envelopes for parsed secret references, maps sidecar outcome metadata to short-lived opaque handles or sanitized failures, and performs no OpenBao call, Unix socket I/O, network execution, provider SDK work, raw secret material handling, durable audit-chain write, or cloud runtime dispatch.

bounded_contexts.name: audit-tap
bounded_contexts.description: Preview source-level audit-tap orchestration for Intelligence events. Builds audit-event-envelope-v2 metadata, includes a metadata-only audit-chain adapter seam, and now includes a deterministic source-level worker seam for job validation, not-before deferral, retry/exhaustion, and sealed/error event receipts; Ed25519 signing, Merkle construction, network execution, durable queue processing, durable writes, and cloud runtime deployment remain future responsibilities.

bounded_contexts.name: assist-draft
bounded_contexts.description: Preview source-level advisory draft planning for no-code builders per ADR-0219 and ADR-0220. The assist-draft kernel validates metadata-only tenant/principal/context/prompt/output-contract refs, consent/budget/policy/model-route/guardrail provenance, human-review-only draft gates, supported builder-surface/draft-kind pairs, and external sensitive data-class boundaries. The assist-draft domain binds kernel planning to tenant/principal policy decisions, locale and brand refusal banners, cost-floor disclosure refs, builder capability scope, allowed surface/kind/audience/data-class/action/locale caps, automation policy, policy-drift checks, and kernel-denial preservation. The assist-draft usecase adds in-memory idempotent receipt orchestration, metadata-only requested/planned/denied/conflict audit events, conflict detection, domain/kernel denial mapping, and invalid metadata short-circuiting. The assist-draft adapter adds a source-level metadata-only executor seam with HTTPS/non-local endpoint validation, opaque credential/audit/executor-audience refs, planned usecase receipt binding, assist-draft executor envelope construction, and accepted/queued/completed/error outcome mapping. The assist-draft API and REST source-level crates add tenant/principal/authorization/request binding, stable HTTP-shaped statuses and structured errors, in-memory idempotent API replay/conflict handling, framework-free POST route constants/handler mapping, and redaction-safe boundary failures. The assist-draft worker adds leased job metadata validation, not-before deferral before side effects, metadata-only usecase plus executor-adapter dispatch, worker events, deterministic retry/exhaustion for rate-limit/error/timeout outcomes, and nonretry invalid/denied mapping without prompt rendering, model/provider calls, builder mutation, HTTP serving, network execution, durable queue processing, durable idempotency, durable audit-chain emission, serialization framework work, or runtime dispatch.

bounded_contexts.name: context-aware-retrieval
bounded_contexts.description: Preview metadata-only context-aware retrieval planning and worker orchestration. Kernel/domain/usecase/adapter/worker source-level crates validate opaque query refs, tenant-scoped candidates, source-kind/freshness/data-class policy, idempotent usecase receipts, metadata-only audit events, retrieval-executor envelopes with HTTPS/non-local endpoint plus credential/audit/executor refs, and leased worker attempts with not-before deferral plus deterministic retry/exhaustion/nonretry mapping; vector-store calls, embedding generation, ontology/KG runtime execution, document fetch, REST/runtime execution, durable queues, and cloud deployment remain future work.
